risk_note: Crash reporting for the five backend processes (api / worker / admin / payout / stream, all through apps/api/src/entry.ts runEntry) with @sentry/core 11.12.0 only (QA-13c) and a hand-written minimal Node integration: fetch transport wrapping createTransport (envelope endpoint, DSN public key auth, redirect manual and never followed, timeout, failures swallowed with one warn without the DSN), V8 stack-line parser, process hooks that report and flush with an upper bound before the existing uncaughtException / unhandledRejection exit behaviour (unchanged), logger.error hook (also structured lines without an Error object), recursive allow-list scrubbing through platform/logging/redaction.ts (no request / response bodies, headers, query strings; user only as a non-reversible hash; promotion URLs, codes, slots, channel ids dropped). CRASH_REPORT_DSN optional: unset → nothing initialised, no hooks, startup unaffected; invalid → ConfigError naming the variable, never quoting the value. The DSN path must be exactly /<numeric project id> (D10-3319, approvals 225); the transport takes the envelope endpoint from the same config-layer normalisation. payout initialises only for a private IPv4 literal host (ledger patch 1, D10-3283); anything else: not initialised, one warn. No money arithmetic, no payout or ledger code touched. Recorded out of scope: staging envelope check by ops after merge (D10-3242 / D10-3244); ADR-0001 line 38 deviation note by the orchestrator (D10-3243); money r4 S2s FU-CRASH-DSN-DOT-SEGMENTS and FU-CRASH-SCRUB-ESCAPED-JSON.
